newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC closes slightly firmer. [CORRECTED 17:34 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC closes slightly firmer. [CORRECTED 17:34 GMT]

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter market (OTC) closed slightly firmer on Wednesday, when prices moved sideways and traders expected profit-taking to lead to minor falls in high-caps prices on Thursday.
Prices for 114 stocks rose on Wednesday, while 106 fell and 276 remained flat.

Independent indices VAB-RA, computed by Vanguard securities, rose to 3,737.4 (corrects index level from 2,737.4) points, and BIG-OTC, compiled by the BIG brokerage house, went up to 2,762.12, rising by 0.8 percent and 1.1 percent respectively. Both indices are computed on the basis of average prices of OTC listings.

Cement maker Moldocim led the market, with a special deal involving around 300,000 shares at 18,000 lei per share, one trader said. It closed at 29,500 lei, 500 weaker from the previous day. Operators said that only few deals were struck on Moldocim's closing price.
Romcim, another cement maker, closed 1,900 lei firmer at 72,000, but traders expected a downward correction on Thursday.
Oil refineries lost ground on profit taking but traders said listings might start to recover during the week.
Oil refinery Arpechim ended 2,000 lei weaker at 28,000, while Petromidia inched down 500 lei to 20,500.
More than 3.6 million shares were traded on Wednesday when overall turnover soared to 16.7 billion lei from 12.3 billion in the previous session.
